---
name: requirements-analysis
description: Turn user stories or notes into docs/requirements.md through clarification questions. Use for the Requirements stage.
---
Procedure:
1. Read the user stories or notes the user provided. Do not invent details.
2. Extract functional requirements. Give each an ID such as FR-001.
3. Extract non-functional requirements (performance, security, accessibility, reliability, and others the user mentions). Give each an ID such as NFR-001.
4. List constraints and assumptions. Mark each assumption clearly.
5. Ask the user every open question in one batch. Wait for answers before writing the file.
6. Write `docs/requirements.md` with sections: Overview, Functional Requirements, Non-Functional Requirements, Constraints, Assumptions, Open Questions (should be empty before approval).
7. Ask the user to approve the document.
